Current tenders and contract awards

We publish tenders for contracts for services and construction work as well as contracts for supplies (materials and equipment) in Germany in accordance with German and European procurement law on the following digital platforms:

  • GIZ’s e-procurement tender platform
  • Bund.de
  • Tenders Electronic Daily (TED) for EU-wide tenders

For information on our tenders abroad, please contact the relevant country office.

Security notice: Warning about fake e-mails in the name of GIZ

Fraudulent e-mails are currently circulating in the name of GIZ. They are often sent from supposed accounting addresses such as rechnungs-services.com, abrechnungskonto.com or finanzabteilung-accounts.com. These fake emails are aimed at service providers and request, among other things, the disclosure of confidential information, such as outstanding invoices or contact details, with the aim of subsequently falsifying them. Please always check that emails are sent from an official GIZ address (@email).

GIZ asks recipients of such emails to ignore them and not to share any sensitive information.

If you receive such an email or notice any suspicious activity, please inform us immediately at: @email

Please note: disclosing or passing on personal data of GIZ employees and failing to report such incidents constitute compliance violations. We therefore ask all recipients of fake emails to exercise due care in dealing with these risks in the common interest.
